headline: Bruins crush Penguins in road blowout as Zacha leads offensive explosion
morning_brew: Thursday night was a straight-up party on the road. The B's went into Pittsburgh and absolutely dismantled the Penguins, walking away with a 6-2 win that had me grinning from ear to ear. When the boys play with that kind of pace and commitment, it's a hell of a thing to watch, especially seeing the puck movement clicking like it did all night long. This was a statement game that reminds everyone exactly why we’re feeling so good about the state of this roster right now.

Pavel Zacha was the star of the show, but the whole squad was firing on all cylinders. Michael DiPietro stood tall in net and kept things steady while the offense kept the pressure on, and honestly, after that shaky start to the season, watching this kind of dominant, physical performance is exactly what the doctor ordered. I’m not saying anything and I don't wanna jinx it, but this team is cooking right now and that’s three straight wins for the good guys.

Now we look ahead to Sunday afternoon when we return to the Garden to host Florida. It’s a massive test against a team that’s been a thorn in our side, and I’ll be sitting in my chair at one o'clock sharp hoping for another display like we saw against Pittsburgh. In the meantime, the C's are heading down to Charlotte tonight for a Friday matchup, so we’ve got plenty of action to keep us busy in the Hub.

news_digest.dans_take: That wasn't just a win, that was a statement that the B's have arrived.
